hooks.command: if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" =~ (rm[[:space:]]+-rf[[:space:]]+(/|\.|Sources|Tests|.build)|git[[:space:]]+push[[:space:]]+-f|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard) ]]; then echo 'BLOCKED: Dangerous command requires explicit approval' && exit 2; fi

if [[ "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" =~ git[[:space:]]+commit[[:space:]]+.*--no-verify ]]; then echo -e '
❌ BLOCKED: git commit --no-verify

🛡️  Pre-commit hooks are QUALITY GATES that ensure code quality.

✅ CORRECT APPROACH:
   1. Fix the failing check (lint, format, tests)
   2. If you MUST skip a specific check, ask user first, then use:
      SKIP=hook-name git commit -m "message"

📋 Available SKIP targets:
   - SKIP=trailing-whitespace
   - SKIP=end-of-file-fixer
   - SKIP=mixed-line-ending
   - SKIP=swiftlint
   - SKIP=swift-format
   - SKIP=swift-coverage-guard

⚠️  NEVER bypass ALL hooks with --no-verify!
    This violates project code quality standards.
' && exit 2; fi
